t: The LED REX Slim Floodlight is a compact, high-performance solution for commercial and industrial use, delivering 9,000 lumens from 100W with 4000K cool white light and a wide 115° beam angle. Built with a durable black aluminium body, toughened glass lens, and a fully adjustable mounting bracket, it includes an on-board 220–240V driver, 1.5m power flex, and an IP65 rating for reliable outdoor performance.
